configurePresets.name: clang-base
configurePresets.description: Base preset for the Clang/LLVM 22+ toolchain required by Lito. The C/C++ compilers are auto-detected from PATH (prefer LLVM's bin dir, e.g. /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin), so ensure an LLVM 22+ clang-clang++ is first on PATH, or set the CC/CXX env variables.
